note: Synthetic items with known labels, never mixed into inputs.jsonl. They are sent in the same run under the same scheme, so a coder that agrees with everything, or refuses everything, fails visibly. Each item asserts only the labels it is unambiguous about; a label absent from `expect` is not checked.
